title: Scroll Caustic Blast
html:
A spell scroll that drops from monsters.

How to get it

Teaches Caustic Blast, a level-2 Acid spell. Needs 20 Intellect and Acid skill 5 to learn and to cast.

Drops from monsters that cast Acid spells, level 8+.

  • A monster that casts spells drops scrolls of its own school, so look for Acid casters.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
  • Also a reward choice from the Dark Witch’s Acid quest.
No monster drops recorded for this item.
